sara: Heads up — bringing up littlewood-13b (community fork) in int4 on canary. Seeing OOMs after ~30m and a weird rise in memory fragmentation. Logs show alloc failures around KV cache resize. Default max_new_tokens is 256. Any quick ideas? @aj @ben

aj: yikes. did you repro locally? is this on dedicated canary or hosted?

sara: canary on ded-gpu-pool-2 (A100s). Local docker with same model + int4 quant config fails similarly when batch_size >= 4 and max_new_tokens >= 200. If I drop batch to 2 it stabilizes.

ben: try prefetch=false and kv_evict_threshold=0.6 — we've hit int4 kv fragmentation before. Also reduce generation window to 512 tokens. Could be slot compaction delay or allocator rounding.

pri: also check slab alignment and try the runtime flag `--prefer-static-alloc`. Our quick heuristic for 13b-int4 onboard: batch 2-3, max_new_tokens 128 default, soft-evict policy.

infra-bot: deploy/canary littlewood-13b-int4 failed healthcheck 1768882255 — rolling back to previous model. :warning:

sara: thanks — rolling back now. Patch I tried: ```redwood run --model littlewood-13b --quant int4 --batch 3 --max_new_tokens 256 --prefetch true```

aj: can you paste the minimal repro request? if we can craft a microbenchmark we can run in CI and iterate faster.

sara: repro prompt (short): `summarize: <10 paragraphs of legal text>` repeated 6x triggers it. Perf tail: ```
2026-03-15T10:02:14Z ERROR OOM alloc 1.2GiB at kv_cache_resize
mem_used: 31.8Gi mem_free: 0.2Gi fragmentation: 0.29 kv_slots_used: 78%
```

ben: fragmentation 0.29 + int4 rounding could push us over. Try `kv_prefetch_batches=1` and `slot_compactor_interval=15s` and lower `kv_evict_threshold` to 0.55 for the canary. Also try decreasing `max_new_tokens` to 128 for the default.

pri: can we pin the quant backend to `qk-fast`? Some int4 backends use different allocation patterns and have lower transient peak. We'll A/B qk-fast vs qk-safe for 1h each.

ci-bot: perf-suite/littlewood-13b-int4 microbench started 1768882300 — status: queued

sara: spun up a short canary with `--batch 2 --max_new_tokens 128 --quant-backend qk-fast --kv_prefetch_batches 1`. Letting it run for 1h and will post results.

aj: if that stabilizes we should update the onboarding checklist to recommend those defaults and add a micro-eval that exercises long summaries to catch mem regressions. :+1:

ben: also add a memory regression alert in Console for fragmentation > 0.25 sustained > 5m (signal = fragmentation * kv_slots_used).

pri: noted — I'll open a PR to docs + infra to add default heuristics for 13b-int4 family and the qk-fast toggle. thanks all :rocket:
